convention: literal line-by-line, rules 1-7 of batch 10's brief
reasoning_summary:
82-87: the 'eyes' couplets keep every repeated oculis on its own line; 84 keeps Arrius' aspirated forms (Chommoda, hinsidias, Hionios) in Latin with notes, and notes that the source prints commode where most editions read commoda.
85: excrucior rendered 'I am crucified' (metaphor kept, noted). 86.4 keeps 'not one ... grain of salt' (wit, noted); Veneres as 'Venuses'.
88-91 (Gellius): coarse sense kept plainly with notes (88.8 self-fellation); 91.5-6 'neither mother nor sister' kept as negated; edebat 'was eating'.
92 keeps 'may I perish unless she loves' without resolving nisi; 108.3 keeps non dubito quin.
95: the lost line 4 keeps the dotted marker with a note on the usual supplement; 95.9 begins 95b.
97-99, 110-113: coarse words rendered plainly (arse, cunt, fucks, pissed-on, prick, pathic, whore); Mentula kept as the name, mentula (115.8) rendered 'prick' with the pun noted; 113.1 notes that the verb is not in the Latin.
Source misprints kept in latin and noted: pose (98.1), deIectant (103.3), facts (110.4); the crux in 110.7 is kept in the English.
Elegiac run-overs left as fragments on their own lines (e.g. 107.7-8 hac ... vita, 113.3-4 milia ... singula, 116.5 laborem).
